ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a stellar 1970 Fillmore set with standout acoustic gems like Swing Low Sweet Chariot and an electrifying St. Stephen > Not Fade Away > Midnight Hour, plus drum‑driven transitions.
ai_review.review: The dusborne matrix fills the gaps left by the soundboard, delivering crystal‑clear acoustic numbers such as Swing Low Sweet Chariot and Attics of My Life, while the electric set shines on St. Stephen > Not Fade Away > Midnight Hour with punchy, drum‑driven segues. Reviewers rave about the overall performance, especially the version of All Over Now Baby Blue, making this one of the most enjoyable 1970 shows available.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (5,4) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and recording quality push the combined weighted score into the 4.4 range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix source compensates for sizable gaps in the original SBD, delivering pure audience (AUD) tracks for the acoustic set and a notably better‑sounding St. Stephen > Not Fade Away > Midnight Hour; drum‑driven transitions are highlighted as clear and impactful.

standout_songs: St. Stephen > Not Fade Away > Midnight Hour
show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set feels intimate and home‑like, followed by an electric portion with seamless, drum‑driven transitions that keep the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drum‑driven transitions praised for adding power to the set
